description: Fresh-host evidence template: installer binds storage_identity to the verified protected registration; all host paths derive from registered data/models roles.
notes: storage_identity must exactly equal the protected registration stable identity (schema, role path/mount/uuid/fstype, and derived roots). Null is intentionally incomplete; no host root or mount identity is implied.
Supply this fresh host's locally verified image ID, supported flags, selected supported load mode and build evidence; a source proof for another host is not an automatic local attestation.
Complete artifact verification for the pinned model revision and record evidence before start.
Set obsolete_boot_owner_disabled only after establishing there is one reviewed lifecycle/boot owner and recording evidence.
D3/I1 must provision exact API token bytes with no trailing newline, mode0600, without printing or recording its value.
